targets.expr: sum(up{job="finance-live-action",monitor="finance-vmagent"} * on(instance) group_left(instrument, broker, market_type, quote_asset) max by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_worker_info{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}))
sum(finance_live_action_worker_ready{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})
sum(finance_live_action_kafka_available{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})
sum(finance_live_action_grpc_serving{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})
sum(finance_live_action_redis_available{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})

sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (rate(finance_live_action_market_data_events_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (rate(finance_live_action_strategy_signals_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset, operation, status) (rate(finance_live_action_worker_operations_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",status!="success"}[$__rate_interval]))

time() - max by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_market_data_last_processed_timestamp_seconds{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"} > 0)

time() - max by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_market_data_last_closed_primary_kline_timestamp_seconds{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"} > 0)

panels.title: Market Data Freshness — Transport vs Closed Primary

panels.description: End-to-end worker processing time from Kafka delivery through strategy evaluation and Redis checkpoint. Open means the exchange can still update the candle; closed means the candle is final.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, event_interval, finality) (rate(finance_live_action_kline_processing_duration_seconds_bucket{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",event_interval=~"$event_interval"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, event_interval, finality) (rate(finance_live_action_kline_processing_duration_seconds_bucket{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",event_interval=~"$event_interval"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Kline Processing Latency — Open vs Closed

panels.description: Strategy evaluation throughput per instrument. A healthy market identity can evaluate often while emitting only occasional trade signals.

targets.expr: sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (rate(finance_live_action_strategy_evaluations_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Strategy Evaluation Rate

panels.description: Share of strategy evaluations that emitted a signal. A low value is normal for selective strategies; zero alongside nonzero evaluations points to strategy conditions not triggering.

targets.expr: sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (rate(finance_live_action_strategy_signals_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[$__rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum by (instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (rate(finance_live_action_strategy_evaluations_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Strategy Signal Yield

panels.description: Worker uptime used by the crash-loop alert. Repeated drops back toward zero identify a worker that restarts instead of remaining healthy.

targets.expr: min by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_worker_uptime_seconds{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})

panels.title: Worker Uptime

panels.description: History events over fifteen minutes. Quality errors page because they invalidate readiness; accepted same-open-time revisions remain diagnostic and do not page.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (increase(finance_live_action_kline_history_quality_errors_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[15m]))

sum by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (increase(finance_live_action_kline_history_revisions_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"}[15m]))

panels.title: Kline History Events

panels.description: History readiness gate used by the one-hour not-ready alert. Zero means strategy evaluation remains blocked for that market identity.

targets.expr: min by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_kline_history_ready{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})

panels.title: Kline History Ready

panels.description: Maximum Kafka lag per consumer group. This is the same signal used by the consumer-lag alert and shows whether a group is recovering or continuing to fall behind.

targets.expr: max by (consumergroup) (kafka_consumergroup_lag{consumergroup=~"finance-live-action-(binance[.]perpetual_future[.](btc|xau)[.]usdt|bybit[.](perpetual_future[.]btc|spot[.]xaut)[.]usdt|exness[.]cfd[.](btc|xau)[.]usd)[.](5m|15m|30m|1h|2h|4h|12h|1d)"})

panels.title: Kafka Consumer Lag

panels.description: Signed safety margin between the decision clock and the newest input actually visible at each evaluation boundary. Zero is the current closed candle, positive is older evidence, and any negative value is a lookahead violation. Runtime and historical backtest are reported separately.

targets.expr: min by (instance, instrument, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset, workflow, evidence_interval) (finance_live_action_no_lookahead_input_lag_seconds{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",evidence_interval=~"$event_interval"} and on(instance, instrument, interval, broker, market_type, base_asset, quote_asset, workflow, evidence_interval) finance_live_action_no_lookahead_checks_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",evidence_interval=~"$event_interval"} > 0)

panels.title: No-Lookahead Verification — Runtime vs Backtest

panels.description: Closed Kafka events processed by the actual candle interval. Over 24h a continuously traded instrument should receive 288/96/48/24/12/6/2/1 candles for 5m through 1d.

targets.expr: sum by (base_asset, quote_asset, event_interval) (increase(finance_live_action_market_data_interval_events_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",event_interval=~"$event_interval",finality="closed"}[24h]))

panels.title: Closed Klines Processed — 24h

panels.description: Age of the last closed candle received for each interval. Before the first close after a deploy, age is measured from worker startup so long intervals get an expected grace window without becoming invisible.

targets.expr: time() - max by (base_asset, quote_asset, event_interval) (finance_live_action_market_data_interval_last_kline_close_timestamp_seconds{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",event_interval=~"$event_interval",finality="closed"})

panels.title: Last Closed Kline Age by Interval

panels.description: Actual evaluation throughput filterable by Alpha or Portfolio layer, configured setup, and event interval.

targets.expr: sum by (base_asset, quote_asset, layer, setup, event_interval) (rate(finance_live_action_layer_evaluations_total{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset",event_interval=~"$event_interval",layer=~"$layer",setup=~"$setup"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Evaluation Rate by Layer and Setup

panels.description: Primary 5m Portfolio boundaries waiting for all synchronized interval evidence. Sustained non-zero values mean a higher timeframe is missing or late.

targets.expr: max by (instance, base_asset, quote_asset) (finance_live_action_portfolio_pending_boundaries{monitor="finance-vmagent",market_type=~"$market_type",broker=~"$broker",base_asset=~"$base_asset",quote_asset=~"$quote_asset"})

panels.title: Portfolio Pending Boundaries

panels.description: Actual candle counts used by the latest production-data portfolio research run. The source commit and run ID labels make each observation auditable.

targets.expr: last_over_time(finance_research_backtest_candles[30d])

panels.title: Backtest Candles by Window

panels.description: Seconds since the latest successful portfolio research run published candle-count evidence. A growing value means the one-shot research workflow has not completed recently.

targets.expr: time() - last_over_time(finance_research_backtest_last_success_timestamp_seconds[30d])

panels.title: Last Backtest Evidence Age
